The Condition Monitoring Engineer leads condition monitoring and predictive maintenance for power plants and utility substation equipment to improve reliability, availability, and asset life. The …
This engineer combines field inspections, online monitoring, diagnostic testing, and operating-data analysis to detect deterioration, assess equipment health, and recommend timely maintenance. The …
Responsibilities

Conduct infrared thermography and ultrasound surveys; assess partial-discharge data where applicable, breaker operating times and contact resistance, insulating-medium condition, and insulation test …
Advanced technical expertise in interpreting transformer dissolved gas and insulating-oil analyses, electrical insulation diagnostics, partial-discharge measurements, and circuit-breaker condition …
